verdict.rationale: PayPal exposes underlying data pieces (list_transaction, get_merchant_insights for ORDERS/SALES analytics, disputes API, refunds API) that could feed a reconciliation workflow, but no evidence documents a settlement report, bank deposit matching, or an itemized report combining fees, refunds, and chargebacks in one artifact. missing for 10: explicit settlement/deposit reconciliation report, fee breakdown reporting, and any evidence tying transaction data to bank deposit matching.
